ZCHAT restarts and offers the kept copy again
ZCHAT closes and starts again, then offers you the kept copy as soon as it can open its storage. Wait until anything you are sending has finished before you continue. Nothing is deleted.
On: ZChat pays handshake transactions and group key answers without asking each time
Off: ZChat pays no setup transaction unless you allow it
ZChat will not pay for a chat setup transaction unless you allow it. A chat or group that needs one waits until you allow it. Messages you send yourself and group joins are not affected.

Everything except a list of your chat contacts\' names

Setting up secure chats sends small on-chain handshakes. They are not messages you wrote, and they cost ZEC: at least %1$s ZEC each, including fees (more if your balance is spread over many small notes). With this on, ZChat pays chat handshakes and group key answers by itself when it sends them, without asking, including handshakes already waiting. Turning this on pays nothing by itself. Joining a group still asks first. You can turn it off again here.
